name: idea2launch
description: Nine-stage guided wizard for non-technical users: bring an idea, get a running web app plus full docs. Thin ZCode shell - registers the idea2launch skill and an L3 intent hint hook; all workflow logic lives in the platform-neutral core.

description_i18n.en: Nine-stage guided wizard for non-technical users: bring an idea, get a running web app plus full docs (idea evaluation, requirements, design, tech, plan, build, quality, delivery, light operations). Thin ZCode shell: skill registration plus an L3 intent hint hook; all workflow logic lives in the platform-neutral core.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向完全非技术用户的九阶段向导：只带一个想法进来，交付可运行的 Web 应用＋全套文档（立项评估→需求→设计→技术→计划→开发→质量→交付→轻运营）。ZCode 壳只做技能注册与 L3 意图提示，全部工序逻辑在平台无关核心。
